news.title: Patch Notes — v0.1.3
news.shortDescription: Quick follow-up patch with a few fixes and improvements — including in-game bug reporting and a wall run rework.
news.fullBody:
Quick follow-up patch with a few fixes and improvements.

BUG FIXES
- Fixed a critical bug that could corrupt save files under specific conditions
- Fixed incorrect particle effects
- Fixed various minor bugs

IMPROVEMENTS
- Improved wall run — easier and more consistent to execute
- Various level design improvements
- Various UI improvements
- Minor performance improvements
- You can now report bugs directly from within the game

KNOWN ISSUES (we're actively working on these)
- Certain languages may display typos or incorrect text

Have a bug to report, a suggestion, or something you'd like to see in the game? Leave a review, use the in-game feedback button, or reach us on Discord. We read everything and do our best to make it happen.

— DWS Interactive

news.title: Guinea Pig Runaway Together Supporter Pack
news.shortDescription: Support the development and get exclusive in-game goodies with the Guinea Pig Runaway Together Support Pack.
news.fullBody:
Want to help us keep rolling?

The Guinea Pig Runaway Together Support Pack is now available. It includes exclusive cosmetic items and shows your support for an indie team of three working hard to make the best guinea pig co-op experience possible.

Every purchase goes directly back into development. Thank you for being part of this journey.

news.title: Vegawon's Legacy — Wishlist Now on Steam
news.shortDescription: A new adventure from DWS Interactive. Wishlist Vegawon's Legacy on Steam!
news.fullBody:
While we keep rolling with Guinea Pig Runaway Together, we also have something else brewing.

Vegawon's Legacy is a separate project from DWS Interactive. We are not going anywhere Guinea Pig Runaway Together development continues as planned.

If you are curious, head over to the Steam page and add it to your wishlist. It means a lot to us.
